mapper.select: SELECT command_id FROM sq_command WHERE action IN ('SUBMIT', 'MESSAGE_SUBMIT', 'MASTER_SIGNAL', 'TASK_DIRECTIVE', 'STOP', 'RESUME', 'RESPOND') AND ((status = 'PENDING' AND due_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'DELIVERING' AND delivery_lease_until < #{now}))AND (sq_command.action <> 'MESSAGE_SUBMIT' OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sq_response_execution current_reply JOIN sq_execution_scope current_scope ON current_scope.user_id = current_reply.user_id AND current_scope.scope_id = current_reply.scope_id JOIN sq_message current_message ON current_message.user_id = current_reply.user_id AND current_message.message_id = current_reply.source_message_id JOIN sq_response_execution earlier_reply ON earlier_reply.user_id = current_reply.user_id AND earlier_reply.conversation_id = current_reply.conversation_id JOIN sq_execution_scope earlier_scope ON earlier_scope.user_id = earlier_reply.user_id AND earlier_scope.scope_id = earlier_reply.scope_id AND earlier_scope.conversation_generation = current_scope.conversation_generation JOIN sq_message earlier_message ON earlier_message.user_id = earlier_reply.user_id AND earlier_message.message_id = earlier_reply.source_message_id WHERE current_reply.user_id = sq_command.user_id AND current_reply.binding_id = sq_command.binding_id AND COALESCE(earlier_reply.dispatch_sequence, earlier_message.message_seq) < COALESCE(current_reply.dispatch_sequence, current_message.message_seq) AND earlier_reply.del_flag = '0' AND earlier_reply.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'RECOVERING', 'RECONCILING', 'CANCELLING') )) ORDER BY due_at, id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_command SET status = 'DELIVERING', delivery_token = #{token}, delivery_lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, delivery_attempts = delivery_attempts + 1, last_error_code = NULL WHERE command_id = #{commandId} AND action IN ('SUBMIT', 'MESSAGE_SUBMIT', 'MASTER_SIGNAL', 'TASK_DIRECTIVE', 'STOP', 'RESUME', 'RESPOND') AND ((status = 'PENDING' AND due_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'DELIVERING' AND delivery_lease_until < #{now}))
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, scope_id, action, binding_id FROM sq_command WHERE command_id = #{commandId}

SELECT earlier_reply.execution_id FROM sq_response_execution current_reply JOIN sq_execution_scope current_scope ON current_scope.user_id = current_reply.user_id AND current_scope.scope_id = current_reply.scope_id JOIN sq_message current_message ON current_message.user_id = current_reply.user_id AND current_message.message_id = current_reply.source_message_id JOIN sq_response_execution earlier_reply ON earlier_reply.user_id = current_reply.user_id AND earlier_reply.conversation_id = current_reply.conversation_id JOIN sq_execution_scope earlier_scope ON earlier_scope.user_id = earlier_reply.user_id AND earlier_scope.scope_id = earlier_reply.scope_id AND earlier_scope.conversation_generation = current_scope.conversation_generation JOIN sq_message earlier_message ON earlier_message.user_id = earlier_reply.user_id AND earlier_message.message_id = earlier_reply.source_message_id WHERE current_reply.user_id = #{userId} AND current_reply.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND COALESCE(earlier_reply.dispatch_sequence, earlier_message.message_seq) < COALESCE(current_reply.dispatch_sequence, current_message.message_seq) AND earlier_reply.del_flag = '0' AND earlier_reply.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'RECOVERING', 'RECONCILING', 'CANCELLING') FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.command_id, c.user_id, c.task_id, c.binding_id, c.action, c.payload_json, c.delivery_attempts, b.agent_id, b.framework_session_id FROM sq_command c JOIN sq_runtime_binding b ON b.user_id = c.user_id AND b.binding_id = c.binding_id AND b.scope_id = c.scope_id WHERE c.command_id = #{commandId} AND c.delivery_token = #{token} AND c.status = 'DELIVERING'

SELECT native_turn_id FROM sq_command WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND action IN ('SUBMIT', 'MESSAGE_SUBMIT', 'MASTER_SIGNAL', 'TASK_DIRECTIVE') AND native_turn_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_command SET status = CASE WHEN #{nativeStatus} = 'rejected' THEN 'BLOCKED' WHEN action IN ('SUBMIT', 'MASTER_SIGNAL', 'TASK_DIRECTIVE') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sq_runtime_binding b WHERE b.binding_id = sq_command.binding_id AND b.user_id = sq_command.user_id AND b.role = 'MASTER' AND b.task_id IS NOT NULL AND b.last_ended_turn_id = #{turnId} ) THEN 'APPLIED' ELSE 'DELIVERED' END, delivery_token = NULL, delivery_lease_until = NULL, native_turn_id = #{turnId}, native_run_id = #{runId}, native_status = #{nativeStatus}, last_error_code = NULL WHERE command_id = #{commandId} AND delivery_token = #{token} AND status = 'DELIVERING' AND delivery_lease_until > #{now}

UPDATE sq_command SET status = 'PENDING', delivery_token = NULL, delivery_lease_until = NULL, due_at = #{dueAt}, last_error_code = #{errorCode} WHERE command_id = #{commandId} AND delivery_token = #{token} AND status = 'DELIVERING'
